items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: For example let's see, Tata Guines and now among those that are new, Los Papines, Los Muñequitos de Matanzas, there are many.

ctx.x: Maestro you told me of Chano Pozo, you told me about Mongo, you told me about you. What other drummers of that era were involved, that today are recognized on that level that you remember?
For example let's see, Tata Guines and now among those that are new, Los Papines, Los Muñequitos de Matanzas, there are many.
And you eventually played with each of them?
